title: English practice
subject: english
source: Written by the Magana team. Our own wording; not past questions. CC BY 4.0.
review: Sample: to be reviewed by a English teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: What is the plural of child?
Which word is a noun?
questions.explanation: A noun names a person, place or thing. A market is a place.

questions.question: Which word is the opposite of early?
She blank to school every day. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: She goes to school every day.

questions.question: In the tall tree, which word describes the tree?
questions.explanation: Tall describes the tree. It is an adjective.

questions.question: Today I eat. Yesterday I what?
questions.explanation: Today I eat. Yesterday I ate.

questions.question: Which word means the same as big?
questions.explanation: Big and large mean the same.

questions.question: Which of these asks a question?
questions.explanation: Where is the pen? asks a question.

questions.question: What is the plural of box?
questions.explanation: We add e s to box: boxes.

questions.question: In Ada sings well, which word is the action?
questions.explanation: Sings is the action. It is a verb.
